test_title: PYST 27 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 22 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: P started walking towards north. He turned 7 times right and 7 times left during his journey. In which direction he will be facing finally?
solution:
Given:

P started walking towards **North**.

He turned **7 times right** and **7 times left**.

Now,

Each right turn = +90° and each left turn = −90°.

Total turns = 7 right − 7 left = 0

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e08d2dfb1fbf23be6dc3d9a1b6559c96ea9c3171dbca7f751f776669110b4232.png] 

So, no net change in direction.

Hence, he will still be facing **North**.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
